tools.name: highlight_create
tools.description: Before preparing, use host web search to research the exact video topic and pass background_research. Prepare YouTube source and Thai transcript locally. No API key. At awaiting_selection the host agent must read highlight_transcript and submit highlight_render; preparation alone does not produce clips.

target_clips.description: 0 = automatic, quality-led count (default). Do not invent 3 or 8. Positive count is a user-requested maximum, never a quota. Discover all worthwhile moments before choosing a batch.

start_seconds.description: Select clips from this absolute time until video end. Defaults to the YouTube t/start timestamp, otherwise 0. Explicit 0 overrides a timestamped link.

comment_signals.description: Observed timestamped comments from this video. Leads for inspection, not proof of humor.

target_clips.description: 0 = automatic, quality-led count (default). Do not invent 3 or 8. Positive count is a user-requested maximum, never a quota. Discover all worthwhile moments before choosing a batch.

start_seconds.description: Select clips from this absolute time until video end. Defaults to the YouTube t/start timestamp, otherwise 0. Explicit 0 overrides a timestamped link.

tools.name: highlight_status
tools.description: Read durable job status without invoking paid analysis. Follow poll_after_seconds; do not spin. Returns measured usage and dashboard_path: open that local HTML in the host preview when available. Unknown quota is not zero; never call the local 30-call cap Google quota.

tools.name: highlight_results
tools.description: List verified clips, including partial ready results. Returns original-source times and artifact paths/resources; outputs may expire.

tools.name: highlight_revise
tools.description: Queue a new immutable revision of one clip using absolute ORIGINAL source times. Preserve original; requires expected_revision. Returns operation job_id. Requires current story_id and topic_id from the source preparation job, and boundary-context reads around the NEW endpoints. Historical clips also require source story review.

max_duration_seconds.description: Explicit user override of the clip ceiling for this revision. Otherwise inherit the job limit.

tools.name: highlight_cancel
tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation. Does not delete files or reverse incurred provider charges.

tools.name: highlight_retry
tools.description: If ingest fails, the host agent owns recovery: follow next_action, try an available supported alternative acquisition method, and resume this same job with highlight_retry.acquired_source (absolute path, source_url, expected_duration_seconds, method). Verify exact video identity and full original timeline first. The server validates media quality and decoding, not content identity. Do not repeat an unchanged failed method, bypass access restrictions or default to asking for MP4. Never claim automatic recovery succeeded without a verified file. Explicitly resume failed, interrupted or waiting work from checkpoints. Uncertain provider outcomes may incur another charge; explain returned warnings. Duplicate retry of active work reuses it.

authorized_browser.description: Use only after explicit user authorization for this job/video. Reads browser session locally; never sends it to third-party download services. none revokes saved authorization.

acquired_source.description: Host-agent acquired full video. Verify exact video identity and duration independently; never substitute an unrelated or trimmed file.

tools.name: highlight_settings
tools.description: Check local FFmpeg readiness. No provider key or remote model configuration is needed.

tools.name: highlight_jobs
tools.description: List retained jobs, newest first, to recover progress after a chat closes.

tools.name: highlight_transcript
tools.description: Read FULL VIDEO transcript pages sequentially, regardless of requested output scope. Records delivery coverage, not comprehension. After reading all pages, save highlight_story. Optional context times read up to 120 seconds for boundary review after story save.

context_start_seconds.description: Optional boundary context query. Supply both times, at most 120 seconds apart. Does not expand allowed selection scope.

context_end_seconds.description: Optional boundary context query. Supply both times, at most 120 seconds apart. Does not expand allowed selection scope.

tools.name: highlight_render
tools.description: Render agent-selected separate clips, each within the requested maximum (default 60 seconds). Requires prepared job awaiting_selection. Repeated identical selection reuses the render job. Prioritize complete meaning over duration. End after payoff/resolution, before a new unfinished thought; never pad to the maximum. Supply opening_reason and ending_reason after checking surrounding context. Requires a saved whole-story map and post-story boundary context reads. Each clip must refer to a story topic_id; supply current story_id.

opening_reason.description: Explain why a new viewer understands this opening and its references.

ending_reason.description: Explain the completed answer/payoff/conclusion. Exclude unfinished new topics. Requested maximum is a ceiling, never a target.

tools.name: highlight_story
tools.description: Get reading coverage and saved whole-story map; or save summary/participants/topics/resolutions after all full-video pages have been delivered. Scope limits output only. Save before shortlisting. Quotes are checked against transcript; meaning remains the host agent responsibility. Updating a story invalidates boundary context receipts. Saving requires background_research either in this story or from highlight_create. Separate external claims from transcript evidence.

comment_signals.description: Observed timestamped comments from this video. Leads for inspection, not proof of humor.

candidate_moments.description: Ranked worthwhile moments after full-story review. Keep unrendered alternatives; actual list length is the found count, never invent totals. Empty means no worthwhile moments found.
